name: RetainerTrustBalanceManager
tagline: Client retainers and trust money under control – thresholds, replenishment, application to invoices and three-way reconciliation.
description: A complete Power Apps code component for law, accounting and consulting firms: evergreen and fixed retainers and client-trust ledgers with replenishment thresholds, approvals, overdraw protection, applying funds to invoices, a replenishment board and a three-way trust reconciliation. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Trust ledgers can never be overdrawn
Cleared vs uncleared funds with cheque hold
Approval rules for applications, refunds, adjustments and transfers
Evergreen replenishment requests with drag-and-drop board
Undo, bulk actions, keyboard and phone layouts
Power Fx outputs and six events
